property: Bipolar data/control interchange signals between the business machine and Bell data set are explicitly documented as conforming to EIA RS-232-A.

date_or_range.notes: Bell interface specification is dated May 1964 and cites the October 1963 RS-232-A revision.

sources.supports: explicit conformance to Electronic Industries Association Standard RS-232-A of October 1963

negative_claims: This edge does not imply that Bell originated RS-232-A or that all Bell data-set families used identical interface implementations.
This edge does not generalize automatically from 202C/202D to 101/103-family interfaces.
open_questions: Catalog other Bell data-set manuals that explicitly cite RS-232 or V-series interface standards.
Identify exact connectors, cable assemblies and option sets used in 202C/202D installations.
